patch.value: Explain joint compatibility constraints with minimal reason chains

Explain package, host and extension incompatibility from declared version constraints and supported capabilities. Acceptance: three incompatible pins report the exact conflict and compatible ranges; unknown metadata differs from incompatibility; every proposed command is a preview with no installs or configuration edits. Deliver typed SDK and CLI, bounded TOON/JSON, typed refusals and remedies, README and example, no-git and read-only public tracker evidence, model-based replay tests, and CI npm plus Bun release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked: ops status/outdated report individual versions; backend-capabilities.ts verifies list/get/schema support; diagnostic-witnesses.ts reduces declared sufficient facts without solving versions. Sibling starter/presets compatibility-floor tests check manifest admission only. Installed SDK authoring exports checkExtensionManifestCompatibility with the loader-shared inclusive bounds; reuse it for extension checks. This feature explains joint declared dependency ranges and capabilities, leaving actual admission authoritative in core. Explicit bounded metadata input only; no registry fetch, install, configuration edit, tracker mutation, journal, claim or outbox path is introduced. Model tests cover JSON/TOON/file replay and SDK state read-back on a non-git tracker; mutation/recovery/status-role requirements do not apply to this observational path.

value.text: Re-review class: never silently discard rejected derived versions and infer an empty version domain. Package-wide search is covering every semver/version decision, SDK/CLI output, packed consumers and no-git paths. Replace handwritten numeric/prerelease successor construction with semver operations and comparator sets; retain library rejections as typed unrepresentable_range evidence naming the affected range. Add max-length prerelease and corpus-based random range-pair regressions, prove failure with only the solver reverted, then run focused and serial full npm/Bun gates with at most two workers. Origin main is already included; no merge is needed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Class audit: compatibility-reasons.ts was the only production module manufacturing semver probe values. It now uses Range comparator sets, intersects, minVersion, inc and validated observed/declared literals only. All library-produced versions are revalidated by semver; rejected values become typed unrepresentable_range records with the range and remedy, including the minimum-conflict path. index.ts and the public SDK share this evaluator. Package-wide search also inspected release-completeness.ts calendar tag formatting and duplication.ts existing-tool major detection: neither synthesizes versions for joint compatibility probes, so changing them would be unrelated. No additional substantive non-blocking findings were present in the supplied finding or GitHub inline reviews. New regressions preserve the existing suite and add maximum-length prereleases, invalid prereleases, numeric overflow, 500 corpus-based random range pairs, JSON/TOON, no-git and packed-consumer coverage. Gate runner concurrency is capped at two with unchanged thresholds.
